task: human-labelled paraphrase identification under adversarial lexical overlap

license.summary: The dataset may be freely used for any purpose; acknowledgement of Google LLC is appreciated.

limitations: PAWS tests semantic paraphrase labels, not every operational definition of train-test contamination.
PAWS-Wiki is English-only and does not establish Russian or Kazakh performance.
The project author selected the public dataset; labels were produced independently by PAWS annotators.
